headlines.title: Does Flexible Libtayo Dosing Change The Bull Case For Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Stock?
headlines.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals reported that the European Commission has approved a new, flexible Libtayo dosing schedule across all existing EU cancer indications, including skin, lung and cervical cancers. The updated schedule introduces options for less frequent infusions and shorter administration times after the initial treatment phase.

headlines.title: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN), Why Is The Market Taking A Closer Look?
headlines.summary: The fresh trigger for Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) is European Commission approval of a new, more flexible Libtayo dosing schedule across all six approved cancer uses in the EU, potentially supporting broader real world uptake. Against this backdrop, Regeneron Pharmaceuticals has seen momentum build, with a 30 day share price return of 21.12% and a year to date share price return of 23.37%. The 1 year total shareholder return of 32.

headlines.title: Regeneron (REGN) Stock Trades Below Fair Value As POTS Trial Progresses
headlines.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals has seen its share price climb over multiple time frames, and with the stock recently closing at US$957.76, the real question for you is whether that level is supported by the earnings the business is generating today. Over the past 5 years the stock has delivered a 48.9% return, which puts real weight on the issue of whether the current valuation is still in step with its earnings power.

headlines.title: CytomX Therapeutics Announces Milestone Achievement in Strategic Collaboration with Regeneron in the Field of Conditionally Activated Bispecifics
headlines.summary: - CytomX to receive $5 million preclinical milestone payment - - The CytomX and Regeneron collaboration began in 2022 and was expanded in June 2026 - EMERYVILLE, Calif., Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CytomX Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: CTMX), a leader in the field of masked, conditionally activated biologics, today announced the achievement of a preclinical milestone for one of the lead programs in its collaboration with Regeneron, triggering a $5 million milestone payment.

headlines.title: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Sees Growth Ahead, Eyes EYLEA HD Syringe Approval
headlines.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:REGN) expects its three largest growth drivers to continue supporting revenue growth, while planning higher research and development spending and preparing for a specialty drug launch, executives said at the Jefferies Healthcare Conference.

description: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. discovers, invents, develops, manufactures, and commercializes medicines to treat various diseases worldwide. The company develops product candidates to treat eye, allergic and inflammatory, cardiovascular, metabolic, neurological, infectious, and rare diseases; and cancer, hematologic conditions. It also offers EYLEA injections for wet age-related macular degeneration and diabetic macular edema; myopic choroidal neovascularization; diabetic retinopathy; neovascular glaucoma; retinopathy of prematurity; Dupixent injection to treat atopic dermatitis and asthma; Libtayo injection for metastatic or locally advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma; Praluent injection to treat heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HoFH); and Kevzara solution for rheumatoid arthritis. It has license and collaboration agreement with Bayer for the development and commercialization of EYLEA 8 mg and EYLEA; Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, Inc. to discover, develop, and commercialize RNAi therapeutics for diseases by addressing therapeutic disease targets expressed in eye and central nervous system; Intellia Therapeutics, Inc. to advance CRISPR/Cas9 gene-editing technology for in vivo therapeutic development for therapies focused on neurological and muscular diseases; Hansoh Pharmaceuticals Group Company Limited to acquire development and commercial rights for HS-20094, a dual GLP-1/GIP receptor; and Tessera Therapeutics, Inc. develops and commercializes TSRA-196, an investigational gene editing therapy for Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency. The company has a strategic collaboration with Telix Pharmaceuticals Limited to develop and commercialize radiopharmaceutical therapies. It also has a strategic collaboration with CytomX Therapeutics, Inc. to create conditionally-activated bispecific cancer therapies. It has a strategic alliance with Sanofi to develop long-acting immunology antibodies. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Tarrytown, New York.
